The predicate `if (cm->new_fb_idx == INVALID_IDX)` is reached when the function `get_free_fb(cm)` fails to allocate a new frame buffer and returns `INVALID_IDX`. The availability of free frame buffers is determined by the reference counting and lifecycle of buffers from previously decoded frames. This entire process is driven by the semantic content of the input video stream provided by the fuzzer. A crafted input stream that causes all frame buffers to be allocated and held as references would exhaust the pool, trigger the allocation failure, and thus reach the blocked code.
